text: Put the blue block into the bowl using tools/robot_ctl.py (session runs/demo_000).
Start from the head camera to locate the block and the bowl.

command: python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'ack step 0' ack_visual --camera cam_head --evidence 'Head: blue block on the left of the table, white bowl on the right; gripper open above the centre.'

cat > /tmp/cells/step_0.py <<'EOF'
BLOCK = np.array([0.42, -0.12, 0.03])
# hover 10 cm above the block, estimated from the head camera
print(robot.reachable(BLOCK + [0, 0, 0.10]))
print(robot.move_to(BLOCK + [0, 0, 0.10], speed=0.15))
EOF
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'hover above the block' cell --file /tmp/cells/step_0.py

text: The wrist view shows the block left of the finger centre line, so the head estimate was off in y by about 1.5 cm.

command: python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'ack step 1' ack_visual --camera cam_wrist --evidence 'Wrist: block ~9 px (about 1.5 cm) left of the finger centre; fingers open.'

cat > /tmp/cells/step_1.py <<'EOF'
BLOCK = np.array([0.42, -0.135, 0.03])
# wrist view: block 1.5 cm further left than the head estimate
robot.move_to(BLOCK + [0, 0, 0.10], speed=0.15)
robot.move_to(BLOCK + [0, 0, 0.015], speed=0.05)
EOF
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --brief --note 'correct y and descend' cell --file /tmp/cells/step_1.py

text: Fingers straddle the block; close and lift.

command: python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'ack step 2' ack_visual --camera cam_wrist --evidence 'Wrist: fingers straddle the block, about 1 cm above the table.'

cat > /tmp/cells/step_2.py <<'EOF'
robot.set_gripper(0.0)
robot.move_by([0, 0, 0.12], speed=0.1)
print(robot.state().gripper_width)
EOF
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'grasp and lift' cell --file /tmp/cells/step_2.py

text: Holding the block. Carry it high over the bowl to stay clear of the rim.

command: python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'ack step 3' ack_visual --camera cam_head --evidence 'Head: block lifted in the gripper; bowl unchanged on the right.'

cat > /tmp/cells/step_3.py <<'EOF'
BOWL = np.array([0.40, 0.18, 0.05])
robot.move_to(BOWL + [0, 0, 0.30], speed=0.15)
EOF
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'carry over the bowl' cell --file /tmp/cells/step_3.py

text: Go slower near the bowl, please.
The carry height was out of reach and the user asked for less speed: 15 cm above the bowl at 0.06 m/s.

command:
cat > /tmp/cells/step_4.py <<'EOF'
BOWL = np.array([0.40, 0.18, 0.05])
robot.move_to(BOWL + [0, 0, 0.15], speed=0.06)
EOF
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --async --note 'carry over the bowl, lower and slower' cell --file /tmp/cells/step_4.py

text: Submitted asynchronously; polling for the result.
Block is centred above the bowl; lower it inside and release.

command: python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'ack step 5' ack_visual --camera cam_head --camera cam_wrist --evidence 'Wrist: block centred over the bowl, about 10 cm above the rim.'

cat > /tmp/cells/step_5.py <<'EOF'
robot.move_to(BOWL + [0, 0, 0.06], speed=0.04)
robot.set_gripper(0.08)
robot.move_by([0, 0, 0.10], speed=0.1)
EOF
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'lower and release' cell --file /tmp/cells/step_5.py

text: The block is in the bowl and the gripper is clear; finish the episode.

command: python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'ack step 6' ack_visual --camera cam_head --evidence 'Head: block inside the bowl; gripper open and clear.'
python tools/robot_ctl.py --session runs/demo_000 --note 'block placed in the bowl' finish

text: The blue block is in the bowl and the episode is finished.
